information.description:
The basic shooters of the ‘tinos are the Gangoons. Lots of faux-style, solid firepower, and little self-preservation. Their weapons are often painted over to look more ostentatious than they truly are, and same goes for their jewelry.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Valentinos).
